$comment: Every outside address the app shows or calls, in one place. Rust reads this file with include_str! (src-tauri/src/links.rs) and the mock engine imports it. The site pages exist on the site branch and go live when the owner deploys it; gumroad_product is a placeholder until the owner creates the product. The stable updater feed is repeated in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json (plugins.updater.endpoints), which Tauri requires; keep the two equal.
